name: Delete
source:
"Delete System": People are born with the right to "kill".

The usage of Delete:
1. Each person can only use it once in their lifetime, and only one person will be deleted.
2. As a civil right, the one who used delete system won't be judged by the law.
3. It is not allowed to give this right to someone else.
4. People with criminal records are not allowed to use it.
5. People under 12 are not allowed to use it.
6. Delete must be applied for at the municipality with the verification ID of the applicant.
7. The target of Delete will be executed by shooting on the day of application.
8. After the execution, the applicant and the target will be shown on the government homepage.

Half a century after the Delete system was spread, it has become a part of daily life. From discrimination, persecution to bullying, after the introduction of this system, all of those have been continuing to decline. The only reason is that, people don't want to be deleted.
translation:
《删除系统》：人与生俱来就拥有“杀人”的权利。

删除的用法：
1、每个人一生只能使用一次，并且只有一个人会被删除。
2.作为一项民事权利，使用删除系统的人不会受到法律的审判。
3、不得将此权利转让给他人。
4、有犯罪记录者禁止使用。
5. 12岁以下人士请勿使用。
6. 删除须持申请人验证身份证件向市政府申请。
7. 删除的对象将在申请当天进行拍摄。
8. 执行后，申请人及对象将显示在政府主页上。

删除系统传播半个世纪后，它已经成为日常生活的一部分。从歧视、迫害到欺凌，自从这个制度出台后，这些都在持续减少。唯一的原因是，人们不想被删除。
